event.title: FSFE local group meeting in Vienna in Vienna, Österreich

body.p: The local group meeting in Vienna, on Friday, the 2nd of October 2026 starting at 16:45 at the Metalab, Rathausstraße 6, 1010 Wien. We'll discuss what happened since the last meeting in May, discuss topics and plans for the future and socialize and chat. Everybody with an interest in Free Software is welcome to join!
